recommendation_title: Next Quarter Priority: Fix Billing's Premium-Only Controls
recommendation: Spotify should prioritize billing/support, specifically the free-tier packaging around Premium-only controls, since it is the single largest issue by volume and severity with 58940 complaints [C001] and a severity sum of 174087 [C002], far ahead of any other issue. This is expressed as a product/packaging decision rather than a technical failure: the issue definition covers song choice, skips, rewind, order, lyrics and similar functions restricted to Premium, and it carries 11558 expressed cancellation-intent mentions [cancellation_intent_count on ISS-BILLING-PREMIUM_ONLY_CONTROLS]. Monthly tracking shows the issue sharply escalating late in the window, from 3.28% share in 2023-04 to 29.22% in 2023-10, making this an urgent, worsening area rather than a steady-state cost.

alternatives.title: Usability (ads, redesign, library/queue)
alternatives.why_not_first: Usability's largest issue, ads, totals 37406 complaints [C009] and severity sum 85318 [C010], well under half the top issue's severity sum [C002], and its area-level mean_severity (2.368709) is lower than billing_support's (2.890637).

alternatives.title: Playback (stops/skips, crashes)
alternatives.why_not_first: Playback has the highest sev4plus count (11374) and strong mean_severity (3.195182), but its top issue, stops/skips, has only 13827 complaints [C013] and severity sum 44042 [C014], a small fraction of the top-ranked issue's 174087 [C002].

alternatives.title: Access (login failures)
alternatives.why_not_first: Access shows the highest mean_severity of any area (3.838968) and login failures have severe per-case impact (severity_sum 31314 [C026]), but overall volume is just 8029 complaints [C025], far below the top issue's 58940 [C001].

alternatives.title: General/other dissatisfaction
alternatives.why_not_first: ISS-OTHER-GENERAL ranks second by priority score with 73774 complaints [C005] and severity sum 147625 [C006], but its definition covers generic praise, generic criticism, and unclear text, so it is not actionable as a specific product fix.
